# Empty

What a region shows when it loaded and has nothing: why, and what to do next.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Brand expressive</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Brand expressive:** A region that loaded with nothing, in playful words with a clear next step. Not while images load; skeleton does that.

- **Use it when:** An empty list, a search with no results, or a first visit with no items yet.
- **Not when:** Still loading (skeleton or spinner), or a load that failed (alert).

Instead:

- [Skeleton](./skeleton.md): Still loading.
- [Alert](./alert.md): Something went wrong.

## How Brand expressive uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">An empty state</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> Playful, with a clear next step</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> A dead end</div></div><div class="cap">Playful words still need a way forward. Example: “Nothing here yet. Go find something you love.”</div></div></div>

## Why it works this way

Empty looks the way it does because of 4 answers about this product. Each card is one answer, in three steps: the answer, what it decided for Empty, and what would move if it changed.

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-content-q1"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What is the main content?</b><code>content.q1</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Images and campaigns</div><p>Images, campaigns and short punchy copy.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Empty</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>default</b>: A campaign image or illustration beside the playful words and a clear next step.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Badge: info</code> <code>Input group: block-start</code> <code>Input group: block-end</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Empty decision would reopen</small><p>and 11 answers that follow from it: <b>One idea at a time</b>, <b>Browse and explore</b>, <b>A display face for brand moments, with a sans for text</b>, and 8 more.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-human-q1"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What must the interface protect?</b><code>human.q1</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Delight</div><p>Delight is the point.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Empty</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>default</b>: A campaign image or illustration beside the playful words and a clear next step.</span></li></ul></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Empty decision would reopen</small><p>and 1 answer that follow from it: <b>Fast</b>.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-iconography-definition"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What icon style?</b><code>iconography.definition</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Two-tone</div><p>Two-tone icons carry the brand color.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Empty</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>icon</b>: A two-tone icon in a tile, for a small region where a picture would push the words away.</span></li></ul></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Empty decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add empty
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.
